hero_subhead: Chapel Allerton Painters transforms your home with expert interior and exterior decorating. We arrive on time, work cleanly, and leave your spaces looking immaculate.
services_heading: Interior & Exterior Decorating Services Across Leeds
services_subhead: From fresh feature walls to complete exterior repaints, we handle every decorating project with precision and care.

services.title: Interior Painting & Decorating
services.desc: Refresh any room with expert wall and ceiling painting, from subtle neutrals to bold accent colours. We prepare surfaces properly and use quality finishes that last.

services.title: Exterior House Painting
services.desc: Protect and refresh your home's exterior with weather-resistant paints and proper preparation. Includes fascias, soffits, doors, and woodwork.

services.title: Wallpapering & Wall Coverings
services.desc: Professional wallpaper hanging on feature walls or entire rooms. We source quality papers and ensure flawless, bubble-free application.

services.title: Woodwork & Joinery Finishing
services.desc: Expertly paint and varnish doors, skirting boards, frames, and built-in furniture. We sand, prime, and finish to a showroom standard.

services.title: Fence & Garden Structure Painting
services.desc: Protect and restore garden fences, sheds, and timber structures with durable exterior paint. Weather-resistant finishes that keep colour vibrant.

services.title: Commercial Painting & Office Redecoration
services.desc: Swift, professional repainting for offices, shops, and business premises. We work around your schedule to minimise disruption.

about_pullquote: We treat every home like it's our own — no shortcuts, no mess left behind.
about_para_1: Chapel Allerton Painters & Decorators has been transforming homes and businesses across Leeds for over 15 years. Founded on the principle that quality decorating shouldn't cost the earth, we've built our reputation by showing up on time, working cleanly, and delivering finishes that genuinely impress. Every job, from a single bedroom to a full exterior, receives the same level of care and attention.
about_para_2: Our customers return to us because they know what they'll get: honest pricing, no hidden charges, and decorating that stands the test of time. We're fully insured, take pride in our craft, and always leave the site cleaner than we found it. Whether you're a homeowner wanting a refresh or a business owner needing a professional makeover, we're here to make it easy.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Brilliant job redecorating our lounge. The lads were tidy, got on with it without faffing about, and the finish is spot on. Even matched the colour I'd loosely described on my phone. Would absolutely have them back.
reviews.author: David T.

reviews.text: Had our kitchen cabinets repainted and they look brand new. Fair price, no mess, and they were done in half the time they said. Can't ask for much more than that really.
reviews.author: Helen M.

reviews.text: Called for a quote on exterior painting and got a call back within 24 hours. Work started promptly and finished to a really high standard. Professional outfit — proper tradesmen who take pride in what they do.
reviews.author: Mark W.
